description: One-launch fixed-shape BF16 packed q/k/v depthwise short-conv, SiLU, and cache update for GDN-2 decode.

y.initialization: NaN poison; every element must be overwritten.

new_cache.initialization: NaN poison; every element must be overwritten.

domain.layout: Kernel ABI flattens the public [1,1,6144] x/y and [1,6144,4] cache through zero-copy contiguous views.
domain.precision: BF16 x/cache/weight; four products accumulate in FP32; SiLU is FP32; y narrows once with ties-to-even; cache is a bit-preserving copy.
domain.ownership: block_dim=8 yields 16 vector participants; each owns 384 complete channels and there is no cross-core synchronization.
domain.aliasing: All inputs are read-only; y and new_cache are fresh complete-overwrite outputs with disjoint storage.

default.reason: FP32 FMA order and native exponential may differ from the independent Torch tree before the final BF16 RNE.

new_cache.reason: The cache update only permutes existing BF16 storage values and must not alter any bit.

measured.static: Pinned Ascriptor 0.1.0: 0 errors, 0 warnings, 203 surface operations; CCE emitted 231 lowered operations.
measured.simulation: All 3 cases passed functional sim and pipesim. Both outputs matched exactly, including the bitwise cache rule; pipesim reported no event imbalance, hazard, or deadlock and modeled 2215 cycles.
measured.board_cce: Canonical unit runner executed all 3 cases through requested_backend=cce and launcher=aclnn. BF16 y and new_cache matched the independent CPU reference exactly in every case.
measured.public_runtime: Two process orders with warmup=100/repeat=500 passed. CCE y/cache matched the CPU oracle exactly; torch_npu y differed from that oracle by max_abs=0.015625 and relative-L2=3.304e-3, while its cache was exact. Public eager CCE measured 40.987/42.002 us versus torch_npu composition 31.793/31.820 us, so aclnn host/allocation overhead makes this boundary slower outside graph.
measured.whole_model: Real 95B BF16 packed model passed both backend orders. Prompt/step logits relative-L2=3.260e-3/4.044e-3; worst prompt/step recurrent cache=9.111e-3/9.313e-3 and convolution cache=7.132e-3/7.270e-3 under the 1e-2 budget; argmax and offsets matched. CCE decode was 6.481/6.885 ms versus torch_npu 9.480/10.011 ms in the two orders, but these are backend-level rather than isolated before/after-short-conv numbers.
measured.profile: In 54 silicon samples the kernel mean/median/min/max was 3.374/3.363/3.072/4.078 us per layer. Mean AIV MTE2/Vector/MTE3/Scalar ratios were 57.59/8.84/9.18/22.13%; their 97.74% sum shows the bulk-read schedule is essentially serial. It removes 18 Conv2D, 18 Cat, 18 Slice and 18 Swish launches per token in favor of 18 custom calls: a same-host cross-acquisition comparison shows whole-model launches falling 604->550/token and device-kernel time 3800.169->3197.959 us/token, a provisional 602.210 us (15.85%) saving. Every custom-kernel row reported the selected physical device; a same-card adjacent-process profiler/graph A/B remains the final performance gate.
measured.scheduling_negative_control: Static three-way 128-channel buffering was numerically correct and hazard-free but increased pipesim from 2215 to 3745 cycles; asymmetric 256+128 buffering increased it to 2819 cycles. With only three vector tiles per participant, extra NDDMA/MTE3 setup exceeds the legal overlap, so both are rejected before silicon. Reaching one pipe near 80% without sacrificing latency requires widening into packed projection, not artificial work or smaller transfers.
measured.scheduling_note: An initial random-only acquisition was contaminated after launch by an unrelated container and is excluded from timing. The accepted all-case run placed actual launchers on the selected device; its fresh compiler probe briefly touched a separately allowed idle device. The accepted profiler saw only the task PID on its selected device; an external VLLM job arrived several minutes after the profile had completed. A later stateful-graph run proved capture/replay correctness bitwise, but another VLLM process entered the chosen device seconds before the model process and overlapped the whole run; its 3.124 ms timing is explicitly rejected. A clean same-card graph before/after remains pending.

provenance.disposition: The depthwise width-four decode formula was independently implemented; no upstream kernel source was copied.

release_scope.note: Repository-owned model-specific inference unit; not part of Ascriptor 0.1.0.
